BOM remains project-specific and is intentionally deferred until topology and operating constraints are evaluated
resolved_issues: 1804-SAM-P45 pop-up height corrected from 150 mm to 102 mm
3504 performance table rebuilt with correct nozzle labels
3504-PC-SAM expanded into six included nozzle configurations.
Compatibility is no longer empty: exact, conditional, functional, and explicit incompatible relationships are encoded for the full catalog.
Control-cable conductor capacity is represented as a project-level formula rather than a fixed product pair.
Drip fittings are no longer classified as dripline emitters.
Endkappe 32 mm corrected to PE compression 32 mm
Hunter HC-601i-E added as a six-station indoor Hydrawise controller with built-in Wi-Fi and 24 VAC valve control.
Hunter PGP Ultra nozzle-host port added so the standalone PGP/I-20 nozzle set can be selected by interface instead of by name.
Incorrect generic Rain Bird manufacturer assignments removed; HydroPC reassigned to Rivulis
Manifold, 100-DV-MM, SPX-FLEX, SBE-050/075, sprinkler and drip fitting ports added
PE25 PN10/SDR11 conflict made explicit; uncertain SDR and derived wall dimensions removed
PE25/PE32 saddle 1/2 inch outlets corrected from 2 inch to 1/2 inch
PGP Ultra performance data separated into blue standard and gray low-angle nozzle families
PGP-04 Ultra expanded into twelve included blue/gray nozzle configurations; unsupported catalog options are identified but blocked.
Plain PE16 distribution pipe is no longer marked pressure-compensating and coil lengths are corrected to 25/50/100 m.
R-VAN adjustable nozzles now explicitly exclude 360 degrees; full-circle models are separate physical variants.
R-VAN14-360 bundle corrected from the adjustable R-VAN14 table to the official 360-degree table.
R-VAN18 precipitation value 0 corrected to 15 mm/h for 270 degrees at 3.8 bar
Standalone PGP blue nozzle set now carries its official performance table.
Unknown retailer thread standards no longer produce false direct compatibility.
calculation_ready changed from optimistic defaults to verified per-product status

intentionally_deferred.bom: A final BOM depends on the user project topology, quantities, hydraulic calculation, station count, cable route, and resolution of all conditional thread standards.

unresolved_issues: Exact NPT/BSP variant is absent from retailer cards for XCZ-100-PRF and PRF-100-RBY.
Exact flow for arbitrary R-VAN arcs and for manually reduced radii is not published as a complete continuous table; application-derived results must be labelled derived.
Exact solenoid inrush and holding currents are not normalized for every 24 VAC valve card; controller-to-valve relations remain conditional until current is checked.
Exact thread standard is absent from the source card for generic manifolds and threaded fittings; sizes/genders are present but the standard is marked source_not_specified.
HC-601i-E is a legacy HC family model; Hunter states discontinuation for U.S. and Australia models only, while the requested German retailer still lists the European variant.
HydroPC exact 16 mm / 33 cm / 2.2 l/h manufacturer variant code and pressure range remain unconfirmed.
No currently selectable sector emitter covers 240 degrees at 2.3 m; a verified short-radius 210-270 degree product is required for that geometry.
PE25 pipe manufacturer/variant must be checked because PN10 and SDR11 conflict.
PGP black, dark-green and MPR nozzle families are manufacturer-supported but absent as products; they remain blocked from automatic BOM selection.
Several generic drip fittings and rolls lack store article/manufacturer codes.
Standalone R-VAN18-360 and R-VAN24-360 physical products are absent; they are described as unavailable related variants and cannot enter an automatic BOM.
Valve-box fit remains conditional because assembled manifold envelope and service-clearance dimensions are not fully normalized.
Winterization set and spray-body pressure gauge adapters lack exact port specifications.

automation_readiness.automatic_bom_blocker: Requires a concrete project topology plus resolution of conditional thread standards and electrical/hydraulic operating limits.

automation_validation_examples.reason: R-VAN14 supports 240 degrees but must not be reduced below 2.4 m; current 3504 and PGP options have larger minimum radii.

configuration_schema.purpose: Machine-readable separation of a commercial product from its installable physical variants and operating configurations.

hard_constraint_sources: exact rows of official performance tables
selection_contract.interpolation_policy: Values between official table rows may be calculated by the application, but must be marked derived and must not be represented as manufacturer-exact.
selection_contract.catalog_availability_policy: Automatic BOM may use only a physical variant marked this_product, this_bundle, included_nozzle_tree, included_nozzle_rack, or this_nozzle_set.
selection_contract.legacy_calculation_ready_policy: Do not use quality.calculation_ready to choose an emitter configuration; use design_selection.automatic_layout_eligible plus the selected configuration option.

geometry_rules: A continuous arc range confirms that any angle inside the closed interval is mechanically achievable.
A fixed 360 degree nozzle is a separate physical variant unless the rotor mechanism explicitly supports part and full circle in one model.
A radius range alone does not supply an exact flow; exact hydraulic values come from official table rows.
Manufacturer radius-reduction limits describe geometry; flow after reduction is not exact unless separately tabulated.
Strip nozzles use width and length, not a circular radius.
A spray body without a nozzle is not a water-emitter configuration.

confidence_levels.manufacturer_verified: Direct official manufacturer range or exact table row.
confidence_levels.derived_by_application_not_manufacturer_: Calculated or interpolated by the application from official data.
confidence_levels.retailer_variant_values_present_exact_ma: Retailer values exist, but the precise factory variant is not yet proven.
confidence_levels.blocked: Must not be used for automatic selection.

compatibility_schema.purpose: Conservative machine-readable compatibility for direct ports, conditional joints, electrical/functional relationships, and project-level assembly constraints.

automatic_bom_requires: confirmed port match or confirmed functional relation
complete path from source to endpoint
pressure/flow/current constraints evaluated at project level
selection_contract.conditional_relation_policy: Conditional relations are candidates for manual verification and must not enter an automatic BOM until every listed requirement is satisfied.
selection_contract.missing_relation_policy: Absence of a relation means not proven, not automatically incompatible.
selection_contract.direction_policy: Hydraulic inlet/outlet roles and flow direction must be respected; bidirectional connector ports may connect in either direction.
selection_contract.thread_policy: Nominal size and gender do not prove compatibility when either thread standard is source_not_specified or variant_not_resolved.
selection_contract.brand_policy: Brand equality is never required by itself; normalized electrical, hydraulic, interface, and installation constraints control compatibility.

relation_statuses.confirmed: Exact normalized interface or manufacturer-supported functional relation.
relation_statuses.conditional: Plausible and size-compatible, but one or more blocking facts must be verified.
relation_statuses.incompatible: Known interface, size, voltage, or component-family conflict.

1/2 thread standard verified or exact NPT chain used
